bounded_slice: Source-pin exact rmcp-v3.1.4 JsonObject/InputRequests/InputResponses wire/container shapes and define one minimal application-owned serializable durable payload row that rejects status/payload mismatch without relying on TaskPayload serde; stop before task transition/redriver work.

findings.json_object: JsonObject<F=Value> is serde_json::Map<String,F>; default JsonObject is serde_json::Map<String,serde_json::Value>.
findings.input_request: InputRequest is a non_exhaustive serde-untagged enum restricted to CreateMessageRequest, ElicitRequest, and ListRootsRequest.
findings.input_requests: InputRequests is BTreeMap<String, InputRequest>; keys are server-assigned request identifiers.
findings.input_responses: InputResponses is BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>; keys correspond to InputRequests and response values are deliberately opaque JSON because heterogeneous ClientResult does not provide the traits needed as a BTreeMap value.
findings.task_payload_boundary: rmcp TaskPayload itself is not Serialize/Deserialize; DetailedTask owns custom wire serde via DetailedTaskWire. Its deserializer requires the status-required field but does not provide an application persistence format for TaskPayload.
findings.durable_row_rule: Persist an application-owned schema-versioned payload record with explicit kind plus exactly three optional slots: input_requests/result/error. Validate exact field presence for the kind, then separately require DurableTaskRow.status == payload kind's TaskStatus before constructing rmcp TaskPayload. Unknown schema versions, extra fields, missing required fields, nonmatching extra payload fields, and status/payload mismatch fail closed.
findings.serialization_rule: Serialize/deserialize the application-owned StoredPayloadV1, not rmcp TaskPayload. JsonObject, InputRequests and InputResponses have exact serde-capable underlying shapes in the pinned release. Reconstruction converts only after validation into TaskPayload and then DetailedTask::new, which re-forces the public Task.status to the payload status.
findings.input_responses_scope: InputResponses is source-pinned for the next transition slice but is not part of current TaskPayload/GetTaskResult storage; it belongs tasks/update processing and should be validated separately rather than mixed into the current-state payload union.
findings.compiler_surface: No cargo or rustc executable is exposed in this runtime; Rust compile success is not claimed.
